description: Simply put, South Dakota is facing an affordability crisis. The cost of living has gone up significantly, with housing being a significant part of this crisis. Affordability is one of the most consistent concerns I hear from South Dakotans as I travel across our state. And while they may be at very different stages of life, two groups in particular are feeling the pressure: first-time homebuyers and seniors living on fixed incomes. In June 2026, the median home sold in South Dakota for $335,000,
title: The Rising Cost of Having a Place to Call Home
